thought

The leaf itself is still green in parts, which is not consistent with the completely dried and brown leaf in the test image. This rules out Sooty_Mould.

Based on the comparisons, the test image most closely matches the symptoms of Die_Back. The rolled-up, brown, and scorched appearance of the test image is highly consistent with the description and the reference image for Die_Back.
